combine_algebra_rule.isaac_sim_container_pin: Isaac Sim 5.1.0 (/isaac-sim/VERSION = 5.1.0-rc.19+release.26219.9c81211b.gl in isaac-sim_5.1.0.sif) ships omni.physx-107.3.26+107.3.3.lx64.r.cp311.u353 and omni.physx.foundation-107.3.26+107.3.3.lx64.r.cp311.u353; libomni.physx.plugin.so compiles PX_PHYSICS_VERSION = 0x05060100 (mov edi, 0x05060100 at offsets 0x352f5f and 0x3536b1), matching NVIDIA-Omniverse/PhysX tag 107.3-physx-5.6.1 (PhysX 5.6.1, not 'PhysX 5.1' and not main/5.12).
combine_algebra_rule.precedence_rule: effective_mode = max(mode0, mode1) with eAVERAGE(0) < eMIN(1) < eMULTIPLY(2) < eMAX(3) (PxMaterial.h:112,127-130 at tag 107.3-physx-5.6.1); staticFriction_eff = max(staticFriction, dynamicFriction) (PxMaterial.h:148); effective restitution = 0.0 for normal impact speed < bounce_threshold_velocity = 0.5 m/s (env/environment/base_env.py:27).

sources.conditions: Lines 48-50 at tag 107.3-physx-5.6.1; verified against 0x05060100 in /isaac-sim/extscache/omni.physx-107.3.26+107.3.3.lx64.r.cp311.u353/bin/libomni.physx.plugin.so.

dormant_values_quarantined.trigger: Fixing #58 alone (binding RigidObject.physics_material before SingleRigidPrim.__init__ flushes to PhysX).
dormant_values_quarantined.effect_if_activated: Bottle material jumps from 0.5/0.5 to 10,000/10,000. Against unbound Table (0.5), Dustbin (0.5), and X5 Fingers (0.5) under average combine, pair friction jumps from 0.50 to 5,000.25 (and bottle-bottle to 10,000). Table slide drops from 24.55 mm to 0.0 mm (#57/#58): pushed standing bottles topple instead of sliding, off-centre grasps never slip or pivot even at 4 kg (#26), and bottles can hang up on dustbin inner walls.
